result.topic_en: Calculations on the distribution of prime pairs (primes whose successor prime differs by more than g), modelled heuristically with the logarithmic integral, together with Gamma-function integrals and asymptotic expansions of the logarithmic integral.
result.transcription:
$\int_1^\infty \frac{1}{x^{s+t}}\partial x = \frac{1}{s+t-1}$
$\int_0^\infty e^{-\log x\, t} t^\alpha \partial t = \frac{\Pi(\alpha)}{(\log x)^{\alpha+1}}$ $\int_0^\infty \frac{t^\alpha}{s-1+t}\partial t = (s-1)^\alpha \int_0^\infty \frac{t^\alpha \partial t}{1+t} = \frac{\pi}{\sin \alpha\pi}(s-1)^\alpha$
$\int_1^\infty \frac{1}{x^s (\log x)^{\alpha+1}}\partial x = -\Pi(-1-\alpha)(s-1)^\alpha$
$\varphi(g,x)$ = Anzahl der [-auf einander folgenden-] [-Primzahlen-] [-welche[?] differiren[?] und-] kleiner als $x$, [-deren-] [-für die-] nächst folgende um $g$ grösser sind.
$\int \frac{\partial x}{\log x} = \varphi(2,x) + \varphi(4,x) + \varphi(6,x) + \cdots$
$x = 2\varphi(2,x) + 4\varphi(4,x) + 6\varphi(6,x)$
$\int \frac{\partial x}{\log x} = \frac{1}{2}\int \varphi(g,x)\partial g$ . $\int \varphi(g,x)\partial g = g\cdot\varphi(g,x) - \int \varphi'(g,x) g\, \partial g$
$x = \frac{1}{2}\int \varphi(g,x)\, g\, \partial g$
$\frac{1}{\log x}$
$\frac{\varphi'(g,x)}{\varphi(g,x)} = -\frac{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}{x}$
$\log \varphi(g,x) = -g\left(\frac{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}{x}\right)$
$\varphi(g,x) = C e^{-g\frac{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}{x}} = \frac{2\left(\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}\right)^2}{x} e^{-g\frac{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}{x}}$
$\int_0^\infty \frac{C}{2} e^{-g\frac{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}{x}}\partial g = \frac{C}{2}\frac{x}{\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}}$ [-$\frac{\int\partial x}{}$-] $= \int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}$
$\frac{2\left(\int\frac{\partial x}{\log x}\right)^2}{x}$
$\int \frac{\partial x}{\log x} = \frac{x}{\log x} + \int\frac{\partial x}{\log x^2}$ -
[-$\frac{x}{\log x}$-]
$\frac{x}{\log x} + \frac{x}{\log x^2} + \frac{1\cdot 2\cdot x}{\log x^3}$
$\frac{4}{(\log x)^2} - \left(\sum_1^\infty \Pi n \log x^{-n-1}\right)^2$
$4\left(x^{\frac{1}{2}}\sum \Pi n{-}1 \log x^{-n}\right)\left(+\frac{1}{2}x^{-\frac{1}{2}}\sum_1^\infty \Pi(n-1)\log x^{-n} - x^{-\frac{1}{2}}\sum_1^\infty \Pi(n)\log x^{-n-1}\right)$
$\frac{4}{\log x} +$ $\frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{\log x} - \frac{1}{2}\sum_1^\infty \Pi n \log x^{-n-1}$
